page_note: Heavily damaged page (68% damage ratio) but textually pure substrate. Page contains cosmological teaching about the soul, living spirit, light/darkness pairing, the five elements, the great fire of dissolution, and a systematic enumeration of four evil counterparts (paralleling four light counterparts). Each counterpart is mapped to a cosmic faculty (king of darkness=soul, evil counsel, desire, law of sin). The only editorial overlay is the brief teaching-transition formula in segs 14-16 ('Once again I have spoken... I will instruct you') which wraps the enumeration introduction. The systematic 'The first/second/third/fourth counterpart is...' structure is canonical substrate enumeration.
